title: Learning from a Biased Sample
one_line_what_it_does: Conditional Gamma-biased sampling: selection probability may depend arbitrarily on observed X but residual (unobservable) odds bounded by Gamma; DRO decision rule robust to it; notes equivalence to Aronow-Lee model
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Core selection model (arbitrary dependence on observed covariates, bounded residual odds); they do NOT do population-mean partial identification, clusters, or PPI

title: Interval estimation of population means under unknown but bounded probabilities of sample selection
one_line_what_it_does: Sharp bounds on population mean of ratio (Hajek) estimator when selection probabilities lie in [a,b]
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Gamma-type sharp interval for a population mean from a non-probability sample (no covariates, no clusters, no PPI); described via Miratrix et al. intro

title: Shape-constrained partial identification of a population mean under unknown probabilities of sample selection
one_line_what_it_does: Tightens Aronow-Lee bounds with shape constraints; R package scbounds
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Sensitivity/partial-ID interval for cohort mean from selected sample; no auxiliary regression, no clusters

title: Sample-constrained partial identification with application to selection bias
one_line_what_it_does: Valid CIs for optimal value of partially identified problems; logistic-odds selection sensitivity parameters Lambda; tightens bounds with known population-level auxiliary constraints (UK Biobank)
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Odds-ratio sensitivity bounds + population auxiliary information + inference; unit-level, not clusters, not PPI

title: Sharp Sensitivity Analysis for Inverse Propensity Weighting via Quantile Balancing
one_line_what_it_does: Sharp population bounds under Tan's marginal sensitivity model (MSM) and estimation; refines Zhao-Small-Bhattacharya
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Mean under MSM with covariate-conditional selection = missing-data/selection mean; direct machinery for sharp Gamma-bounds on cohort mean given f

title: A distributional approach for causal inference using propensity scores
url_or_doi: seen only as reference in https://arxiv.org/pdf/2212.09844
one_line_what_it_does: Introduces the marginal sensitivity model and LP bounds
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Origin of MSM

title: Sensitivity analysis for inverse probability weighting estimators via the percentile bootstrap
url_or_doi: seen only as reference in https://arxiv.org/pdf/2209.11383
one_line_what_it_does: Bootstrap CIs for MSM bounds on IPW estimators
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Inference for MSM bounds (conservative)

title: Covariate Balancing Sensitivity Analysis for Extrapolating Randomized Trials across Locations
one_line_what_it_does: MSM-type optimization bounds on target-location effects given sites with trials; sharper bounds by balancing covariate moments
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Sensitivity bounds for extrapolation across locations (sites ~ clusters) with covariate balancing; ATE not PPI; 'few sites' not studied

title: Sensitivity analysis for the generalization of experimental results
one_line_what_it_does: Three-parameter bias decomposition for weighted generalization estimators; percentile bootstrap CIs; benchmarking
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Sensitivity for non-random selection into sample; weighting estimators for treatment effects

title: Global sensitivity analysis for studies extending inferences from a randomized trial to a target population
authors: Dahabreh, Robins, Haneuse, Robertson, Steingrimsson et al.
one_line_what_it_does: Odds-of-selection / exponential tilt sensitivity for trial nested in a cohort of eligible individuals
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Cohort-nested design where covariates known for all; unit-level

title: Sensitivity analysis for an unobserved moderator in RCT-to-target-population generalization of treatment effects
one_line_what_it_does: Sensitivity analysis for unobserved moderator in generalization
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Earlier sensitivity-for-generalization

title: Omitted-Variable Sensitivity Analysis for Generalizing Randomized Trials
one_line_what_it_does: OVB decomposition + partial-R2 sensitivity for trial generalization
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Alternative non-MSM parametrisation

title: Transporting Trial Evidence Under Posterior Drift and Possible Hidden Confounding
one_line_what_it_does: Rosenbaum-type uncertainty set on generalized propensity score with minimax drift estimation
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Gamma-type uncertainty for transport; ATE

title: Proxy Pattern-Mixture Analysis for Survey Nonresponse
one_line_what_it_does: Proxy X = linear predictor of Y fitted on respondents, known for everyone; taxonomy of bias evidence from proxy strength and respondent-vs-overall proxy mean gap; sensitivity analysis over nonignorability parameter
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Predictions-as-proxy + label-free representativeness diagnostic + sensitivity parameter: directly the SENS diagnostic idea (unit-level, Gaussian pattern mixture)

title: Measures of the degree of departure from ignorable sample selection (SMUB)
one_line_what_it_does: Standardized measure of unadjusted bias based on PPMM for nonprobability samples; extended to proportions (Andridge et al. 2019 JRSSC) and regression coefficients (West et al.)
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Index of potential selection bias for non-probability samples using auxiliary proxy known in population

title: How Generalizable Is Your Experiment? An Index for Comparing Experimental Samples and Populations
one_line_what_it_does: Generalizability index B in [0,1] from propensity-score (sample membership) distributions of sites in sample vs population; label-free
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Label-free representativeness diagnostic for a convenience sample of sites/clusters

title: Implications of Small Samples for Generalization: Adjustments and Rules of Thumb
one_line_what_it_does: Properties of similarity statistics and PATE estimators with 10-70 sites; large chance imbalance in small samples
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Few-site (10-70) behaviour of label-free representativeness diagnostics

title: AI-Generated Measurements for Identification and Inference with Missing Data: A Weak Shadow Variable Approach
one_line_what_it_does: Sharp LP bounds on population quantities under MNAR using AI-generated proxies conditionally independent of missingness given Y and X
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: AI predictions + MNAR partial identification of a mean; but assumes proxy independent of missingness given Y (opposite of selection-on-predictions); unit-level

title: Demystifying Prediction Powered Inference
one_line_what_it_does: Review/flowchart of PPI variants; MOSAIKS demo shows all PPI methods biased under MNAR; recommends covariate diagnostics for labeled-vs-unlabeled comparability
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: States the PPI-under-MNAR gap and diagnostic need; offers no sensitivity method

title: Prediction-Powered Inference with Inverse Probability Weighting
one_line_what_it_does: HT/Hajek-weighted PPI for informative labeling with known/estimated propensities (MAR)
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Selection on observables only; no sensitivity

title: Double Robust Semi-Supervised Inference for the Mean: Selection Bias under MAR Labeling with Decaying Overlap
one_line_what_it_does: DR semi-supervised mean under MAR labeling
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: MAR only

title: Beyond the Training Distribution: Evaluating Predictions Under Distribution Shift and Selection Bias
one_line_what_it_does: DML estimate of target risk under covariate shift + selective labels on observables
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: MAR selection; no sensitivity bounds

title: Prediction-Powered Inference
one_line_what_it_does: PPI with covariate-shift and label-shift variants (known weights)
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Known-weight shift only

title: Cluster-Robust Prediction-Powered Inference
one_line_what_it_does: Cluster-robust PPI++ SEs, partially labeled clusters; text searched: no mention of sensitivity/selection/representativeness
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Clustered PPI; confirms no selection sensitivity there

title: Beyond reweighting: On the predictive role of covariate shift in effect generalization
one_line_what_it_does: Across 65 sites, strength of unobserved conditional shift is often bounded by observed covariate shift (pivotal measures); random shift model gives UQ
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Data-driven calibration of how large residual shift can be from label-free covariate shift between sites: an alternative to a free Gamma

title: Data Fusion for High-Resolution Estimation
one_line_what_it_does: Fuses unbiased low-resolution and biased high-resolution data under sampling-bias model where observables act arbitrarily
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Uses selection-bias model with external population constraints

title: Inference from Nonrandom Samples Using Bayesian Machine Learning
one_line_what_it_does: ML prediction of outcomes over population from nonrandom sample with aux info
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Ignorability-based; no sensitivity

title: Designing multi-site studies for external validity: Site selection via synthetic purposive sampling
one_line_what_it_does: Selects sites so non-selected sites are approximated by weighted selected sites; worst-case MSE
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Design-side few-site selection; not sensitivity

title: Externally Valid Selection of Experimental Sites via the k-Median Problem
authors: Montiel Olea, Prallon, Qiu, Stoye, Sun
one_line_what_it_does: Minimax-regret site selection = k-median
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Design-side site selection under bounded cross-site heterogeneity

title: External validity in policy evaluations that choose sites purposively
one_line_what_it_does: Conceptual model of purposive site selection bias
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Purposive/convenience site selection framing

title: Distributionally robust and generalizable inference
one_line_what_it_does: Worst-case and random-shift stability of estimands under distribution shift
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Generic shift sensitivity

title: Valid Inference with Synthetic Data via Task Exchangeability
one_line_what_it_does: Validity via exchangeability with historical tasks, extensions beyond exchangeability
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Tangential: structural-exchangeability alternative to selection modelling

title: Semiparametric semi-supervised learning for general targets under distribution shift and decaying overlap
authors: Testa et al. (per Song et al.)
one_line_what_it_does: DR semi-supervised under MAR with vanishing overlap
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: MAR only
